pages.text: Down on Bone Street, the lamps come on. Biscuit the corgi puppy trots along to say goodnight.
The old yellow labrador is asleep on the porch. Woof, goodnight.
The dalmatian counts her spots, then curls up in her basket.
The pug snores in his little bed. Snort, snuffle, snore.
The poodle has her curls brushed, then flops on the rug.
The dachshund is so long he needs two pillows.
The husky sleeps outside under the stars, nose in his tail.
The sheepdog dreams of sheep. His paws twitch. Run, run, run.
The greyhound folds herself up small in a big soft chair.
The moon comes up over the roofs of Bone Street.
Biscuit trots home, tired paws going pat, pat, pat.
Biscuit curls up in his basket by the door. Woof, goodnight, everyone.
